base_exp: exp_010 D (47 provided columns, strongly regularised LGBM); diagnosis source exp_018
question: does a deviation-offset slope fitted only on earlier seasons transfer to the held-out season?
changed_vs_exp_018: stage-2 offset added (C1/C2/C3); C0 is spec-identical to exp_018 A0
platoon columns are NOT in the design matrix at all
two extra stage-1 blocks (2020, 2021) exist to source OOF residuals
fold_2022 is reported at a chained P10 iteration, not its own argmin
prelim_stats not re-run (the lookup is byte-identical)

prereg.slope_estimator: no-intercept least squares of (y - p) on d, pooled over all rows of every eligible earlier block, unweighted
prereg.why_no_intercept: an intercept is a global probability shift, i.e. the exp_005 season-drift correction, a different mechanism that was measured to hurt this base (+3.0e-5)
prereg.rows_used_in_the_slope_fit: ALL rows of the block, F-league included
prereg.why_all_rows: the correction is applied to all rows at validation and at deployment, so the fitting population is matched to the application population. The variant that drops the exp_004 masked rows is reported as a sensitivity, NOT as a fallback
prereg.residual_iteration: each block's own P10 iteration (block 2020: its own argmin, no predecessor exists)
prereg.decision_rule: adopt iff all 3 seeds share the sign AND |mean delta| >= 3 x C0 seed std

mask: training rows with season<=2022 & game_type=='F' dropped (exp_004); validation untouched

leak_boundary.design_matrix: 47 provided columns only, in every arm
leak_boundary.as_of: row of season s uses a table built from seasons <= s-1
leak_boundary.slope_fit: only blocks with season < the fold's validation season
leak_boundary.d_on_lookup_miss: exactly 0 — the estimator's own no-op, not a sentinel fill of a missing value
